name: mainline_objective_attribution_v1
analysis_type: Retrospective mechanism and source-support diagnosis, not an optimizer experiment or held-out validation.
target_protocol: Reuse full-role histories through paid12, all8 identities and1024 nodes, unchanged raw update and64-node streaming. Retain node f moments/masses at prefixes0..12. No new model or precision setting.
decomposition: Per observed raw, telescope within-node mean change, f-node mass change and common identity mass change. Split identity change by the average of f-then-g and g-then-f evidence order. Preserve target and initial contributions separately. Sum per-raw contributions for0->10 and10->12.
validation: Compare all recorded focal/initial f/g mean, marginal variance and noise at prefixes10/11/12; stop on drift. Check telescope sums. Validate difference variance once against original full-covariance projection. These detect replay/projection errors before interpreting contributions.
source_protocol: Existing Inventory/Queue64sites x3raw only. Deterministic within-task nearest-neighbor pairs in frozen standardized public mean10, symmetrized/deduplicated. Compare observed objective differences and observation variance with frozen source common-law means and common/task/white contrast variances. No new per-task coefficient fitting. All source data were used in fitting, so no holdout claim.
decision_boundary: Diagnose first; no target-truth-tuned objective/risk patch, new model selection or fresh optimization cohort in this stage. Read existing target truth only for reporting, after projections saved.
additional_support_diagnostic: Compare actual source/query joint20 and learned f designs; source reconstruction detects an inconsistent provider or scale. Distances are descriptive, not proof of extrapolation or a selected model change.

next_step.single_candidate: For each existing identity match kind and task-covariance mode, reuse its frozen head_specific objective response pair (f,eta_f) and corresponding designs. Keep the role g conditional model and original source identity weights; no source refit.
next_step.comparison: First source0/initial10 projection checks, then all six stage31 saved full-role trajectories with unchanged candidate pools/raw/precision. Preserve original model as fixed reference. Evaluate target difference and unsampled prediction only.
next_step.limits: Target common identity weights still update and may alter risk predictions. This is a modular response-pair intervention including objective noise and source dependence changes, not a pure mean/basis ablation. No transferred deployment credit or target-truth tuning.
next_step.rationale: Within-node objective updates dominate ranking reversal; actual joint design has sparse source support despite public-coordinate proximity. Existing head_specific source-pair fit is worse, so it is a diagnostic candidate, not an adopted fix.
